QuestInfo.name: Gaga's Confession
QuestInfo.0: Gaga wants to confess his feelings to someone on Valentine's Day. Who could the lucky girl be?\n
QuestInfo.1: Help Gaga confess his feelings to the Maple Administrator by bringing him 100 Pieces of wrapping paper.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 100 Gift Wrapping Papers to Gaga. Keep collecting them so Gaga can turn his crush into a successful relationship.\n

0.0: *Sigh*... It's Valentine's Day once again, a day for star-crossed lovers and matches made in heaven... *Sigh* Hm? Oh, don't mind me... I'm just...well....I never thought that I would be one of those love-struck dreamers, but... Look, can you help me out?

yes.0: I knew I could count on you! The thing is...I'm in love with the Maple Administrator!
yes.1: Seeing her dedication in running all these events over the years has finally made me go ga-um, crazy for her! I want to confess my feelings, but I've gotta do it in style, just like she runs her events. So, I need 100 Gift Wrapping Papers.

no.0: Really? Oh. I guess...our love just wan't meant to be...

1.0: Do you have all 100 Gift Wrapping Papers? I can't afford to go halfway on my love!

yes.0: Thank you so much! With your help, XX, I can work up my courage, back it with a mind-blowing gift, profess my love, and live happily ever after! If you keep bringing me sets of 100, I can do this!

default.0: You don't have 100 Gift Wrapping Papers yet? Wh...what about my dream of true love?
